definitions.full: H8253. sheqet שֶׁ֫קֶט noun [masculine] quietness ; — 1Chr 22:9 (+ שָׁלוֺם ).

occurrences.englishText: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.
